requirements: Not a directory — earned editorial via story submissions plus a real 'Op-Ed' route through the contact form
Story submission page on the site (registered-community feature; account signup at techdirt.com)
Submission rules from Techdirt itself: descriptive title, link to an article (NOT a press release), brief explanation of why it's interesting, and it must be recent
Op-Ed requests are an explicit topic on the contact form — Techdirt historically ran the 'Insider Shop'/copia op-ed program
Sponsorship exists via the Media Kit (paid, separate from editorial)
preparation: A story link worth submitting — third-party coverage of your launch, not your own press release
Or a genuine op-ed pitch on tech policy/innovation topics via the contact form
Techdirt's beat is tech policy, IP, innovation economics — a plain product launch is off-beat
workflow: Create a Techdirt account and use the story submission page for news links
For an original op-ed, use the contact form and select 'Op-Ed Requests'
Or email via the contact form's 'Media/Public Relations' topic for press inquiries
Accept that most submissions are not covered — Techdirt gets ~3x more submissions than it can write up
watchFor: Explicitly does NOT want press releases — submit a link to someone else's coverage of you instead
